paraphrase: Signatories affirm they will implement current best practice including internal and external red teaming of frontier models for severe and novel threats.
what_is_tested: Frontier models and systems via red teaming
notes: Whole document is voluntary commitments; timing (pre deployment) not stated in this sentence.

paraphrase: Organisations will assess risks of frontier models across the lifecycle, including before deploying, and as appropriate before and during training.
what_is_tested: Risks of frontier model or system before deployment
notes: Voluntary commitment; assessment method not specified; split from I03.

paraphrase: Risk assessments should take account of model capabilities, deployment context and efficacy of mitigations for foreseeable use and misuse.
notes: Describes content of the risk assessment; weak force (should).

paraphrase: Organisations should consider results of internal and external evaluations as appropriate, such as independent third party evaluators or home governments.
Organisations will assess whether their intolerable risk thresholds have been breached, including monitoring how close a model is to breach.
what_is_tested: Model or system against severe risk thresholds
notes: Not explicitly pre deployment; includes monitoring.

paraphrase: Thresholds should be defined so that it is possible to assess whether they have been breached.
notes: Footnote; design requirement enabling evaluation rather than an evaluation itself.

paraphrase: Organisations will develop and deploy models only if they assess that residual risks would stay below thresholds.
what_is_tested: Residual risk after mitigations before development or deployment
notes: Deployment gate based on assessment; no method stated.

paraphrase: Organisations should have processes to assess and monitor the adequacy of mitigations and identify further mitigations as needed.
notes: Borderline: includes monitoring; evaluation activity is assessment of mitigation adequacy.

paraphrase: Organisations will explain how external actors such as governments, civil society and academics are involved in assessing risks of their models.
notes: Transparency about external assessment, not itself a testing requirement; include as weak.
